license_note: The repositories ship no LICENSE file; the gated model cards link the governing Gemma Terms of Use, whose appendix lists Gemma 3 and which incorporate the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy by reference. The terms restrict use rather than grant open source rights, so these releases are source-available, in contrast to the Gemma 4 generation's Apache-2.0 carve-out.

license_evidence.scope: Official google/gemma-3-27b-it repository, Safetensors weights, tokenizer, processor, and chat template
Restricted-use policy incorporated by reference into the Gemma Terms of Use

access_boundary: This record represents the google/gemma-3-27b-it release of March 2025 at Hugging Face commit 005ad3404e59d6023443cb575daa05336842228a. The other Gemma 3 sizes, the Gemma 4 generation, quantizations, fine-tunes, and independent serving providers remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Dated March 2025 release with pinned repositories and a full technical report
Google documents Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, and on-device runtimes
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind acceptance of Google's restricted Gemma Terms of Use
Google no longer documents served copies of Gemma 3 on the Gemini API and treats the line as legacy without a retirement note
